title: His current six-piece band and a trio at Charlottesville
summary: His current band uses the six-piece New Orleans instrumentation; a trio played at a University of Virginia jazz concert with Arthur Herbert on drums.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: How many are in the Paris band now?
There are six now, the regular New Orleans instrumentation.
You never did play many jobs, did you, with smaller groups like trios? You had that trio you did with Naki once. What was that on the road?
Well, that was played at the University of Virginia in, I think, Charlottesville, Virginia. Only at jazz concerts, but mostly with the Six Beast group.
